rules: Do not mirror, commit, or redistribute third-party sports data unless upstream terms explicitly permit this exact use.
Publicly accessible does not mean licensed for republication or AI use.
Keep credentials in environment secrets; never commit API keys.
Store null for unavailable statistics; never infer missing values as zero.
Record provider, source URL, source record ID, fetched_at_utc, license reference, and dataset version for every imported partition.

nba_data.reason: No repository LICENSE file found during inspection; upstream data originates from stats.nba.com and ESPN. Do not mirror until rights are confirmed.
nba_data.coverage_notes: Stats.nba.com from 2009-10; ESPN net-points data from 2018-19. Game IDs encode preseason, regular season, All-Star, playoffs, Play-In and NBA Cup final.

open_matchday.reason: Dataset terms allow informational non-commercial use with attribution, but upstream providers' terms still apply. Some upstream data is personal/non-commercial only. Do not mirror or redistribute without confirming rights for every upstream source.
open_matchday.coverage: 2026/27 current season; 75 competitions; uneven stats; not a full 2025-26 archive.

football_data_co_uk.reason: Upstream terms restrict use; no automated AI/product dataset ingestion without express permission.
